entries.name: Voice vortex
entries.description: A soft spectral ring breathes around the mic. Hold it: the ring swells to 118%, spins three times faster and pulses like a live voice. Let go and it springs back.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  swell: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 160, damping: 18, mass: 1 }, // grow on hold, settle on release
  speed: 10,  // tenths of the base spin (1.0×)
  boost: 3,   // spin multiplier while listening
  size: 118,  // % the ring grows to while held
  blur: 18, palette: 0,
}

entries.name: Rotary deck
entries.description: Cards fan on a circle behind the headline and turn slowly. Drag to spin: the deck coasts on release, a fast drag fans it wider and it springs back. Cards turning away fade.

entries.name: AI aura input
entries.description: The prompt bar glows brightest on one side and that peak swings toward the pointer. Focus lifts it; Enter sends the aura round the pill while it thinks, then the answer card unfolds from under the bar on a spring.

spec.Answer: spring k170 · c24 · drop 14 px · scale .94 → 1 · blur 8 → 0
spec.Text: spring k120 · c20 · trails the card

entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  magnet: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 40, damping: 11, mass: 1 }, // how the bright side swings to the pointer
  think: 1500,  // ms the aura orbits before the answer
  rise: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 170, damping: 24, mass: 1 }, // answer card in (ζ ≈ 0.92: settles, no visible bounce)
  decode: 14,   // ms between letters as the reply decodes
  orbit: 14,    // tenths of a turn per second while thinking (1.4 turns/s)
  theme: 0, bezel: 8, glow: 60, follow: 1,
}

entries.name: Glass grid
entries.description: Three blurred lights sit under 72 frosted tiles and lean toward the pointer. Drag to paint them under your finger; tap a tile and a ripple runs out through the grid by distance.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  follow: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 60, damping: 14, mass: 1 },  // lights drifting toward the pointer
  paint: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 170, damping: 22, mass: 1 },  // lights under a dragging finger
  ripple: 560, // ms one tile takes to dip and return
  wave: 46,    // ms per tile of distance from the press
  depth: 9,    // % the pressed tile sinks (scale 1 → .91)
  palette: 0, diffusion: 60, frost: 55, gap: 3, drift: 1,
}

entries.name: Acrylic card arc
entries.description: Sixteen acrylic cards on a curve, out-of-focus by distance. Drag or scroll to turn the set, tap a side card to bring it to the centre, tap the centre card to lift it and tilt it with the pointer.

entries.name: Glyph matrix
entries.description: A subject is sampled for brightness and redrawn every frame out of glyphs. The butterfly breathes, characters shimmer, glyphs part around the pointer and a press sends a shockwave through the field. Swap the glyph set from the dock, or upload your own image.

entries.name: Dotted globe telemetry
entries.description: A Fibonacci-lattice globe of 3,200 dots, land kept and the ocean thinned to a graticule, lit and sized by depth. Drag it on both axes and it coasts, then drifts. Six data overlays ride the rotation: node pills, great-circle arcs with packets, radar beacons on an obsidian sphere, edge-tower load cards, rim weather badges and a low-orbit mesh.

entries.name: Liquid voice split button
entries.description: Tap the mic: the light capsule springs out into a live waveform pill while the cancel droplet is pushed out to the right and settles beside it, still joined by a thin liquid neck. Tap the pill to send, or tap × and the droplet is drawn back in and the two merge into one circle. An SVG metaball filter shapes the hulls; icons, bars and timer stay sharp on top.

spec.Droplet: 52 px · +104 px · spring k170 · c15 · neck stays
spec.Material: gradient + sheen + traced rim + drop shadow

entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  capsule: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 22, mass: 1 }, // main pill 64 → 168 px
  droplet: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 170, damping: 15, mass: 1 }, // cancel droplet eject / retract (lags → bridge)
  eject: 104,   // px the cancel droplet travels right — close enough that a liquid neck stays at rest
  goo: 11,      // feGaussianBlur stdDeviation
  bars: 5, tone: 0, dark: 0, wave: 0,
}

entries.name: Swiss card stack
entries.description: Six editorial cards in one cascading stack. Drag it 1:1: the rear cards spread like an accordion and the front card tilts with the pull. Flick and the release is projected to the nearest card; the front card dips on an arc and tucks behind the deck.

spec.Wrap: smoothstep + sin arc 98 px · z flips at 0.48

entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  snap: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 110, damping: 19.5, mass: 1 }, // release snap (×tension, damping ×√tension)
  dwell: 2600,  // ms the deck rests before Auto cycle deals the next card
  spread: 24,   // px between stacked card tops
  taper: 0.085, // scale lost per card of depth
  tension: 1,   // spring tension multiplier
  auto: 1,
}

entries.name: Dual-lens agent
entries.description: Two glass lenses orbit on a figure-eight above a frosted card while a pearl light leak on the left rim follows the pointer. Ask something: the lenses tighten, the status words light up letter by letter, then the lenses merge into one bright core.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  rim: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 90, damping: 16, mass: 1 },     // left rim light following the pointer's height
  merge: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 140, damping: 14, mass: 1 },  // lens gap opening / closing between states
  think: 2700,  // ms from send to Complete (three status words)
  orbit: 10,    // tenths of the base orbit speed (1.0×)
  sweep: 10,    // tenths of the letter sweep speed
  blur: 6.5, glow: 70, state: 0, dark: 0,
}

entries.name: Spatial metric cards
entries.description: Six gradient glass metric cards ride one continuous position: drag or scroll and it coasts with momentum, drifts on its own, and snaps to the nearest card when drift is off. Six 3D engines read the same position — cylindrical carousel with lens stretch, liquid refraction, orbital helix, prism accordion, zero-G grid and portal vortex. Three charts scrub under the pointer.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  drift: 24,     // hundredths of a card per second while auto-drifting (0.24 cards/s)
  damping: 4,    // hundredths: velocity keeps this share per second (vel *= 0.04^dt)
  snap: 7,       // magnetic snap rate once velocity settles (drift off)
  follow: 12,    // how fast each card settles onto its target (mode switches, grid push)
  mode: 0, palette: 0, warp: 72, depth: 1150, auto: 1, dark: 0,
}

entries.name: Agent thinking loaders
entries.description: Six circular telemetry loaders drawn on canvas: latitude scan, harmonic beads, telemetry pulses, equaliser, orbital aperture and quantum lattice. Tap one to lift it into the hero with a pulse ring; status changes the tempo of all six.

entries.name: Room light dimmer
entries.description: A tall pill slider dims the room photo: fill follows the finger 1:1, the room darkens and warms, and overshoot springs back.

spec.Release: spring k500 · c30 back into range

entries.name: Model picker swipe
entries.description: Swipe between models: the outgoing photo leaves, the new one slides in behind it, the name and each spec roll on their own beat.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1],
  photoMs: 800, // photo slide (parallax: the new one travels less than the old one)
  fadeMs: 350, // photo cross-fade
  rollMs: 550, // name + spec rolls
  specStagger: 50, // ms between spec figures
}

entries.name: Café order
entries.description: One ordering card where every change moves on its own beat: the ring slides to the drink you pick, the quantity rolls and the total trails it digit by digit, and Add to cart sends the photo arcing into the cart before the badge pops.

spec.Digits: spring k400 · c30 · 40 ms apart, R → L

entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  select: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 32, mass: 1 }, // ring slides to the picked drink
  digit: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 30, mass: 1 }, // quantity + total roll
  press: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 600, damping: 30, mass: 1 }, // keys and button
  stagger: 40, // ms between digits, right → left
  lead: 120, // ms the total waits after the quantity
  fly: 650, // ms the photo takes to arc into the cart
  arc: 28, // px the flight rises above the straight line
}

entries.name: Swipe to add
entries.description: A deck of profile cards: the front one follows the finger and tilts from a pivot below it, “add” or “nah” blooms in with the drag, and past the threshold it is thrown off along its own arc while the next card rises on a soft spring. The buttons read the same drag.

spec.Snap back: spring k500 · c30 · keeps release velocity

entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  rise: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 22, mass: 1 }, // next card steps forward
  release: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 500, damping: 30, mass: 1 }, // let go short of the threshold
  tilt: 11, // px of drag per degree of tilt
  threshold: 90, // px past which a release throws the card
  flick: 600, // px/s that throws it regardless of distance
  throw: 700, // ms the thrown card takes to leave
}

entries.name: Circle cursor
entries.description: One white shape, three states: a 16 px dot, a 96 px lens over links (difference blend), and a labelled pill over work cards. It morphs while it trails the pointer.

entries.name: Buy → confirm morph
entries.description: The button becomes its own progress indicator: it folds into a circle, spins, lands a check with one beat, then opens back into the label. It wears the glow CTA: hover and a light runs round the rim with a soft halo, and it keeps running while the button works. Click the demo.

spec.Check: draw 300 ms ENT · beat 1.05× · ink → green 200 ms
spec.Return: hold 650 ms · expand 500 ms · label rises 16 px
spec.Glow: conic rim 1.5 px + 9 px halo · 2.2 s lap

entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  morph: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], // width ↔ circle
  morphMs: 500,
  spinMs: 600,
  checkMs: 300,
  labelOutMs: 120,
  glowSpin: 2200, // ms per lap of the rim light
  magnet: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 18, mass: 0.6 }, // pull toward the pointer (30% of the offset)
}

entries.name: Hotspot tooltips
entries.description: Hotspots breathe on the product. Tap one: its tooltip springs out from the dot and the others step back.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  pop: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 30, mass: 1 }, // tooltip out of the dot + dot scale
  text: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], // tooltip lines rise
  textMs: 350,
  breathe: 1600, // ms per idle pulse
  camera: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 170, damping: 26, mass: 1 }, // push-in / pull-out on the photo: soft, no overshoot
  zoom: 1.9, // how far the camera pushes in on a detail
}

entries.name: Feature callouts
entries.description: Callouts arrive one at a time on the product photo: the dot springs onto the part, the line draws out, the label rises. Hover one to focus it.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  dot: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 30, mass: 1 }, // dot springs in
  line: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], // line draws out + label rises
  lineMs: 450,
  labelMs: 350,
  gap: 600, // ms between callouts
}

entries.name: Hold to redeem
entries.description: Redeeming is deliberate, so it is a hold: the fill grows while pressed, drains if you let go early, and on completion the voucher turns over to the code.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  hold: 1200, // ms of pressing to redeem (linear on purpose: it is a progress bar)
  drain: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], // fill drains back if released early
  drainMs: 350,
  flip: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 160, damping: 20, mass: 1 }, // voucher turns over
  check: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 18, mass: 1 }, // tick pops on the back
}

entries.name: Rolling price
entries.description: Every digit rolls on its own column with a spring, left to right, and the total trails the quantity. Only digits that change move. Tap + and – to try it.

entries.name: Scroll text reveal
entries.description: Every character brightens from grey to white as the paragraph travels up the viewport, so reading speed follows scroll speed. Scroll inside the card.

spec.Split: words share progress evenly, letters split their word

entries.name: Reel card → player
entries.description: The play pill leans toward the cursor on a light spring. Click and the card itself grows into the player, so the viewer never loses the thing they clicked. Hover and click the demo.

spec.Pill follow: spring k420 · c34 · m0.6 · 35% of offset

entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  grow: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], // card → player and back
  growMs: 750,
  scrimMs: 500,
  closeDelay: 200, // close button arrives last
  pill: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 34, mass: 0.6 }, // play pill follows the cursor
}

entries.name: Night → day
entries.description: The whole surface changes theme in one curve: background, ink and icon move together. Click the demo to switch between day and night.

entries.name: Image cursor
entries.description: A portrait rides the pointer over the list and flips through the project photos, lagging on a spring so it feels carried rather than glued.

entries.name: Work card hover
entries.description: The image eases in, a hairline and a marquee banner cross the middle, and the title rolls to its twin. Hover or tap the card.
entries.motion:
export const MOTION = {
  ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], // line, title roll and image zoom
  rollMs: 600, // title roll + line draw
  zoomMs: 900, // image scale 1 → 1.06
  bannerMs: 300, // marquee fade
  marqueeMs: 6000, // one loop of the banner
}

entries.name: Capabilities accordion
entries.description: Rows unfold to their own height while the plus turns into a minus. One open at a time, hairline rules in Light Grey 20%.

entries.name: Nav letter roll
entries.description: Links are split into letters; on hover each letter rolls up to a blue twin, 25 ms apart, so the word ripples left to right.
